resource.name: GpxToFusion
resource.creator: DorwinDT
resource.category: Productivity scripts, workflow bridges, and integrations
resource.description: Turn GPX or drawn routes into editable Fusion polylines, map images and Text+ labels. Windows app; map-provider licenses remain separate.
resource.access: Free; MIT code; map-provider terms separate
resource.platformNotes: Windows 10/11 x64, unsigned portable ZIP with the .NET runtime included. Exact Resolve version range is unknown.

requirements.dependencies: Online map tiles from the selected provider; exported nodes are edited in Resolve Fusion.
requirements.installation: Extract the Windows x64 ZIP and import the exported .setting into Fusion.

evidence.note: Windows 10/11 x64, unsigned portable ZIP with the .NET runtime included. Exact Resolve version range is unknown.

Windows app that exports a GPX or drawn route as an editable Fusion polyline, map image and optional Text+ labels. Includes timing data and route-drawing controls. Map tiles require internet and retain their providers’ attribution and usage terms; the MIT code license does not license map imagery.
Original provider release; not independently installation-tested.
